_comment: Third-party licence policy for release packages (scripts/release_licenses.py). Mirrors backend/deny.toml [licenses].allow for Cargo and applies the same rules to npm. A shipped package passes when its SPDX expression can be satisfied by 'allow' or 'allow_with_conditions' ids. Ids matching 'review' patterns fail the release until the exact package@version is listed in 'reviewed' with a reason. Anything else (unknown, missing, NOASSERTION) fails.

allow_with_conditions.MPL-2.0: File-level copyleft: ship the source of MPL-covered files unmodified or publish our changes to them; linking from proprietary code is fine.
allow_with_conditions.CC-BY-4.0: Attribution: keep the notice in THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md (data packages such as caniuse-lite).

cargo:jsonpath-rust.reason: Cargo.toml has only license-file = LICENSE, which is the MIT text (same clarification as backend/deny.toml).
